compute_heads_importance: compute head attention entropy and importance scores for a BERT model on evaluation data
mask_heads: mask low-importance attention heads in a BERT model until accuracy drops below a threshold
prune_heads: prune masked attention heads from a BERT model and compare performance and speed to masking
run_bertology_entropy: run bertology to compute and save attention entropy and head importance matrices for a pre-trained transformer
run_bertology_masking: run bertology with head masking and pruning to reduce model size while preserving accuracy
